description: This file implements the SchemefulSite class, which manages origin and scheme-related operations, including obtaining site information, serialization, deserialization, and conversions related to web origins and schemes.

classes.name: SchemefulSite
classes.description: A class representing a scheme-aware site, encapsulating origin information and providing methods for obtaining site details, serialization, deserialization, and conversions related to web origins.

methods.name: ObtainASite
methods.description: Determines the site origin based on the provided origin, considering registerable domains and scheme-specific rules.

methods.name: CreateIfHasRegisterableDomain
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite object if the origin has a registerable domain.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite object from a serialized string.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the SchemefulSite to a string.

methods.name: SerializeFileSiteWithHost
methods.description: Serializes the site with its host, specifically for file scheme origins.

methods.name: GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representation of the site.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the site.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two SchemefulSite objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two SchemefulSite objects.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Provides a less-than comparison for ordering SchemefulSite objects.

methods.name: DeserializeWithNonce
methods.description: Deserializes a SchemefulSite from a string with nonce support.

methods.name: SerializeWithNonce
methods.description: Serializes the site with nonce information.

methods.name: SchemelesslyEqual
methods.description: Checks if two sites are equal ignoring the scheme, based on host comparison.
